candidate.claim: Lexer.lex reuses the same instance field this.tokens without clearing it, so a second lex() call on the same _Lexer instance appends new block tokens and links to the previous result instead of starting fresh, double-counting output.
candidate.title: Lexer.lex appends to stale instance tokens on reuse

verifier.reason: Lexer.ts:22 initializes this.tokens once in the constructor and Lexer.ts:87 passes that same this.tokens to blockTokens and returns it without any reset, so a second instance lex() call appends to the prior array.
